an6.21:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Sāmagāmake pokkharaṇiyāyaṃ.
an6.21:1.2: Atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ pokkharaṇiyaṃ obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an6.21:2.4: Ime kho bhante tayo dhammā bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattantī' ti.
an6.21:2.7: Atha kho sā devatā ‘samanuñño me Satthā' ti Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyi. 2.
an6.21:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an6.21:3.2: Imaṃ bhikkhave rattiṃ aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ pokkharaṇiyaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave sā devatā maṃ etad avoca
an6.21:3.6: Ime kho bhante tayo dhammā bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattantī' ti.
an6.21:3.8: idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyi.
an6.21:3.9: Tesaṃ vo bhikkhave alābhā tesaṃ dulladdhaṃ, ye vo devatā pi jānanti kusalehi dhammehi parihānāya saṃvattamāne.
an6.21:4.1: Apare pi bhikkhave tayo parihāniye dhamme desessāmi,
an6.21:4.2: taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī ti.
an6.21:4.3: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an6.21:4.5: Katame ca bhikkhave tayo parihāniyā dhammā?
an6.21:4.7: Ime kho bhikkhave tayo parihāniyā dhammā. 4.
an6.21:5.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānaṃ parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi, sabbe te ime heva chahi dhammehi parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi.
an6.21:5.2: Ye hi keci bhikkhave anāgatam addhānaṃ parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi, sabbe te ime heva chahi dhammehi parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi.
an6.21:5.3: Ye hi pi keci bhikkhave etarahi parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehi, sabbe te ime heva chahi dhammehi parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehī ti. 1.
